saw.headline: Man Utd *sack Michael Carrick* after one league win in ten
saw.what: Manchester United said on Thursday that Michael Carrick has left his role as head coach, with the club in the relegation zone after one win in 10 league games. Sky Sports says Mauricio Pochettino has agreed a deal to replace him. No official announcement had been made when we checked. This follows Wednesday’s report that the club was reviewing his position.
saw.why: A story that grew all week, from a review to a sacking. Football fans are filling feeds.
saw.source: Sky Sports, 12 Nov; BBC Sport, 12 Nov

saw.short: Harry Kane becomes England's most-capped men's player
saw.headline: *Harry Kane* becomes England’s most-capped men’s player
saw.what: Harry Kane won his 126th cap on Thursday, passing Peter Shilton’s 125, then scored the winning penalty, his 92nd England goal, in a 2-1 win over Croatia. BBC says Prince William and Shilton presented him with a framed shirt before kick-off. England are through to the Nations League quarter-finals and play Spain on Sunday.
saw.why: A record, a winner and a royal presentation in one night. A big shared moment.
saw.source: BBC Sport, 12 Nov; Sky Sports, 12 Nov; Metro, 12 Nov

saw.short: Owain Wyn Evans's Children in Need ride passes £2.4m
saw.headline: Owain Wyn Evans’s *Children in Need ride* passes £2.4m
saw.what: BBC Radio 2’s Owain Wyn Evans had raised more than £2.4 million for Children in Need by the end of Thursday’s Day 4, up from £1.2m on Wednesday. His nearly 400-mile ride finishes in Cardiff today, which is also appeal night on BBC One from 7pm. The hosts are Alex Jones, Mel Giedroyc, Rylan, Sara Cox and Tyler West.
saw.why: A feel-good story that doubled its total in a day. Appeal night tonight.
saw.source: BBC live page, 12 Nov; BBC media pack

saw.short: I'm A Celebrity adapts its camp for Ade Adepitan
saw.headline: *I’m A Celebrity* adapts its camp for Ade Adepitan
saw.what: ITV has adapted the I’m A Celebrity camp for Paralympian Ade Adepitan, with deeper pathways, parking bays, rest areas and a stairlift to the jungle shower, per Radio Times and LADbible. ITV’s line-up was confirmed on Tuesday. The series starts on Monday 16 November at 9pm on ITV1 and ITVX.
saw.why: Strong build-up for next week’s biggest TV launch. The camp story adds a human angle.

saw.short: GTA 6 pre-orders are 'far above expectations' as launch nears
saw.headline: *GTA 6* pre-orders are “far above expectations” as launch nears
saw.what: Take-Two says GTA 6 pre-orders are “tracking far above our initial expectations” but hasn’t given a number. Sensor Tower estimates about 10 million, up from its 7.71 million estimate last week. Selfridges opened a pop-up on Oxford Street on Monday and boxed copies started arriving on Thursday. The game launches on Thu 19 Nov.
saw.why: A launch that kept making news all week. Expect a feed takeover next Thursday.

saw.short: Christmas ads kept the week talking: Waitrose, M&S and Disney
saw.headline: *Christmas ads* kept the week talking: Waitrose, M&S and Disney
saw.what: M&S’s “The Home of Christmas”, with James Norton as a beardless Santa, launched on Friday 6 Nov. Disney’s short “The Invisible Horse” followed on 9 Nov. Waitrose released a six-minute sequel on Tuesday, which it calls the longest ad made by a UK supermarket. Quince’s David Schwimmer ad also revived Ross’s red sweater.
saw.why: Christmas ads are the season’s biggest shared talking point. Waitrose and M&S led it.
saw.source: Digital Spy, 6 Nov; Metro, 9–10 Nov; Famous Campaigns, 6 Nov

platform.short: Instagram's Edits had a busy week: a Mac app and Effect Builder
platform.headline: Instagram’s *Edits* had a busy week: a Mac app and Effect Builder
platform.what: Edits launched a Mac app on 5 Nov, with a multi-track timeline and 4K watermark-free export, per Social Media Today and TechCrunch. On 9 Nov Instagram launched Effect Builder, a web tool for AI effects in Stories, but its Edits blog says it is US-only for people over 18.
platform.why: Instagram is pushing creators to its editing app. Effect Builder isn’t in the UK yet.
platform.source: Social Media Today, 5 Nov; Instagram Edits blog, 9 Nov

platform.short: X added clip video and previewed AI moderation labels
platform.headline: X added *clip video* and previewed *AI moderation labels*
platform.what: X now lets users clip videos longer than two minutes into 5 to 60 second shares that credit the original, per X Creators. X’s head of brand safety also previewed designs for labels that explain why its AI flagged a post, Adweek reports. The labels are a design preview, not a confirmed rollout.
platform.why: X made reaction clips easier and talked about moderation. Neither is a UK-specific launch.

platform.short: LinkedIn explained its feed and tested a frequent viewer label
platform.headline: LinkedIn *explained its feed* and tested a *frequent viewer* label
platform.what: LinkedIn’s engineering blog says its Profile Relevance system uses LLM embeddings to match posts from people you don’t follow, and it cut hide rates by 18.8% in tests. Wired reports LinkedIn is also testing a “frequent viewer” label for some Premium users. LinkedIn confirmed the test.
platform.why: LinkedIn is showing how its feed works and testing a profile-view feature.
